item.text:
The cold climate air-source heat pump is **Upgrade 04** (measure ID **hvac_004**), as listed in the [ResStock 2025 Release 1 README, p. 9](https://oedi-data-lake.s3.amazonaws.com/nrel-pds-building-stock/end-use-load-profiles-for-us-building-stock/2025/resstock_amy2018_release_1/README_resstock_20251.pdf#page=9).

It is documented in **[ResStock Measure Documentation: Cold Climate Air-Source Heat Pump](https://docs.nlr.gov/docs/fy26osti/96413.pdf)** by Philip White and Andrew Parker, report **NLR/TP-5500-96413**, May 2026.

I started at your index URL, but the browser returned no readable JSON content; I verified the answer in the release README and report.
